events.name: Gaither Homecoming Christmas: Bill Gaither & The Gaither Vocal Band - Dayton, OH
events.info: Celebrate the wonder of the season with the 2026 Gaither Homecoming Christmas tour. Join Bill Gaither, the beloved Gaither Vocal Band, and an incredible lineup of special guests for an unforgettable evening of Christmas music, Gospel favorites, laughter, and worship. Filled with joyful harmonies, cherished holiday classics, and inspiring songs of faith, Gaither Homecoming Christmas celebrates the birth of Christ and the hope, peace, and love that define the season. From timeless Christmas carols to beloved Gospel favorites, each performance offers moments of celebration, reflection, and encouragement that have made Gaither Homecoming events a treasured holiday tradition for generations. Sharing the stage this Christmas will be special guests Mark Lowry, The Hoppers, Chris Blue, and many more. Whether you're continuing a family tradition or attending your very first Homecoming event, Gaither Homecoming Christmas is an evening designed to bring people together through the joy of music, the warmth of fellowship, and the timeless message of Christmas. Ultimate Fan Pass: 30-min Exclusive On-court Access From 5:30pm-6:00pm
events.info: TICKET TO MAIN EVENT ALSO REQUIRED. Get closer to the action with the all-new Ultimate Fan Pass - a limited-capacity, 30-minute pregame on-court experience featuring the Harlem Globetrotters and their Rivals. Be first through the doors and first on the court, where you get exclusive access up close with the players, learn trick shots from the pros, get one-of-a-kind photos, and kick off your own tip-off party before the rest of the crowd arrives. Ultimate Fan Pass guests also get first access to the merchandise stands before the lines form. A separate game ticket is required and is not included with this experience. Minors must be accompanied by an adult who also holds an Ultimate Fan Pass. Soft- or rubber-soled shoes are required on court. The on-court experience begins 90 minutes before game time. Late arrivals may miss some or all of the experience and are not eligible for refunds.
